en: Black‑and‑white view of a large Gothic and neo‑Gothic complex on a hill, with a massive multi‑storey building in front and an ornate church with two tall, slender spires and openwork tracery rising behind. The steeply pitched roofs have rows of dormer windows. Below the hill are tree‑covered slopes and rooftops of smaller houses partly hidden by blossoming trees in the foreground. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image.
